question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Estimate
solution: The correct answer is '**Assess**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Estimate**' is '**Assess**'. • **Estimate**: an estimate (of something) a guess or judgment about the size, cost, etc. of something, before you have all the facts and figures. (सभी तथ्‍यों के बिना किसी वस्‍तु के आकार, क़ीमत आदि का अनुमान या आकलन) • *Example: Can you give me a rough **estimate** of how many people will be at the meeting?* • **Assess**: to judge or form an opinion about something. (राय बनाना, आँकना) • *Example: It’s too early to **assess** the effects of the price rises.* **Correct Answer:__** *Assess.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Believe**: to feel sure that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth. (विश्‍वास करना, सही मान लेना) • **Solve**: to find a way of dealing with a problem or difficult situation. (किसी समस्‍या या कठिनाई को हल करना या का समाधान ढूँढ़ना) • **Discover**: to find or learn something that nobody had found or knew before. (किसी नई बात का पता लगाना या उसे जानना) 35:Ta74, The erroneous part is **'if they would have'.**
